text:
rachel: throwing an idea on the board: a compact "mini econ pulse" card for Console's rollout view. single-row card per canary with: burn_rate (tokens/min), cache_delta (tokens saved/min), model_efficiency (tokens/resp). updates every 60s. compact enough to sit next to latency/err rate.
omar: v useful. big Q: do we derive tokens from raw token counts or use sampling+estimation? full compute is expensive.
li: sampling is necessary. propose reservoir sampling at the router (configurable rate). also attach a sampling_weight so we can unbiased-aggregate later.
rachel: UX note: need relative deltas vs baseline (control) and a small confidence indicator. even if noisy, show trend arrows.
omar: telemetry routing question: should we emit a dedicated econ event or piggyback on trace/span logs? separate events mean more storage but simpler schema.
li: piggybacking on spans wins for operational simplicity (already persisted), but we lose some retention control. Alternative: write a short-lived econ index (1h) fed from spans that materializes the pulse.
ops-bot: FYI: adding a new short-lived index at 1% sample rate estimated +4GB/day cluster-wide. see https://infra/notes/idx-costs
analytics-bot: analytics: if you need per-model aggregation, you must include model_family + quantized_tag at emit-time. otherwise joins blow up.
rachel: include model_family + quant_tag + route_alias. also tenant_id hashed (to keep sensitive info out).
omar: for cache attribution across chained calls, propose emitting "cache_delta_tokens" per hop plus hop_index so we can attribute to the initiating route.
li: second concern: low-traffic canaries will be invisible at 1% sample. plan: deterministic sample if route is flagged canary, or force-sample first N requests per canary per hour.
ops-bot: deploy note: force-sampled traffic will increase write QPS to metrics pipeline during rollouts; will run under probation window.
analytics-bot: schema sketch (econ.pulse.v1) — fields: [model_family, quant_tag, route_alias, sampled_tokens, sampling_weight, cache_delta_tokens, hop_index, canary_flag, tenant_hash, timestamp]
li: example emitter (ASCII JSON) so SDK folks can test quickly:
```json
{"schema":"econ.pulse.v1","model_family":"luminous-7b","quant_tag":"q4_0","route_alias":"text-summarize-v2","sampled_tokens":98,"sampling_weight":100,"cache_delta_tokens":27,"hop_index":0,"canary_flag":true,"tenant_hash":"h_abc123","timestamp":1738500000}
```
rachel: wonderful. UI suggestion: tiny sparkline + micro-badge: +27 tokens saved (green) or -5 tokens (red) with per-req normalization toggle. clicking card expands to 1h breakdown.
omar: implementation plan: 1) router reservoir sampler + span enrichment (week 1), 2) materializer job to build 1h pulse idx (week 2), 3) Console card reads idx (week 3).
li: devops: add feature flag to flip sampling rate per-cluster. we can ramp safely.
ops-bot: note: set alarms for index write errors and backpressure; will auto-suspend sampling if pipeline errors >5% in 5m.
analytics-bot: retention proposal: keep pulse idx 1h by default, 7d archived at 0.1% sample for trend analysis.
rachel: outstanding debates: span vs dedicated event — leaning span enrichment + materializer. any objections?
omar: fine by me. saves a hop.
li: ok. final checklist: schema PR, sampling hook in router, materializer job skeleton, Console mock, e2e smoke tests. sync Thursday sync slot.
ops-bot: reminder: tag PRs with #econ-pulse for deploy tracking.
rachel: thanks team — I'll draft a 1-page RFC and post in #product-notes.
